topic: A ferry trip to a small island
passage: Last Sunday morning, we set off for a small island by ferry. I packed up a small bag and checked the tickets twice. We arrived at the port at seven and lined up at the window. I filled out a short form and handed over our identity cards. Then we got on the ferry and sat down by a window. The boat pulled away at half past seven, and the city faded behind us. I looked out at the water and pointed out a group of white birds. After one hour, the ferry slowed down and pulled into a quiet harbor. We got off and walked around the old streets. We sat down, ordered two bowls of noodles, and the food tasted fresh. We ended up staying longer than we had planned. In the afternoon, we climbed a short hill and looked over the whole island. The wind picked up, so we put on our jackets and headed back. We caught the last ferry at four and got back after dark. I hung up our wet coats and washed our hands. It was a simple trip, and we promised to go again next spring.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录；今日未连 Mac 读笔记，按日志错题模式出题，弱项还是短语动词连读和过去式听辨，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「坐渡船去小岛」是全新的旅行话题，短文里有 packed/checked/arrived/lined/filled/handed/pulled/faded/looked/pointed/passed/slowed/walked/showed/ordered/tasted/ended/planned/climbed/picked/headed/washed/promised 等规则过去式；set off、packed up、lined up、filled out、handed over、got on、sat down、pulled away、looked out、pointed out、took out、slowed down、pulled into、got off、walked around、wrote down、ended up、looked over、picked up、put on、headed back、got back、hung up 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
